evaluations.query: I am completely confused about how URA determines customs value when transaction value cannot be used. What are the sequential methods under ACV?
evaluations.reply:
Here's the most relevant guidance I found in official URA sources:

Six methods applied sequentially (methods 4 and 5 can swap on importer request): transaction value; transaction value of identical goods; transaction value of similar goods; deductive value; computed value; fallback method.

evaluations.topic: Required Documents at Point of Entry
evaluations.query: Urgent help needed! My container just arrived at the border point of entry. Exactly what documents must I present to customs to clear the goods?
evaluations.reply:
Here's the most relevant guidance I found in official URA sources:

(1) Lodge the export SAD in ASYCUDA; (2) pay any applicable fees or levies; (3) present goods and documents for customs verification/scanning if required; (4) obtain release and exit note; (5) the carrier exits with sealed cargo.

evaluations.query: What health and immigration documents must international travelers present when entering Uganda through Entebbe airport?
evaluations.reply:
Here's the most relevant guidance I found in official URA sources:

Passport valid ≥6 months; appropriate visa (e-visa/embassy/visa-free or on-arrival where eligible); yellow fever vaccination certificate (over 1 year old travelers); COVID-19 PCR within 72 hours if required by current health rules; proof of onward/return ticket.
